## Good news! You are eligible for Child Benefit for all three children.

**Summary:**
You qualify for Child Benefit for **Alex (3 years old)**, **Blake (8 years old)**, and **Charlie (2 years old)**.

**Why you're eligible:**
- All three children are under 16 years old
- All three children live with you in the UK
- You are responsible for them
- None of the disqualifying factors apply to any of your children

**Next steps:**
You can apply for Child Benefit through the UK government. Remember that only one person can claim Child Benefit for each child, so if anyone else is also responsible for these children, you'll need to agree who will claim.

**Important note:**
If you or your partner have an individual income over £60,000, you may need to pay the High Income Child Benefit tax charge. You can still claim Child Benefit, but you might have to pay back some or all of it through your tax return.
